Q9015.reason: Enzymes are proteins, and which proteins a cell makes is dictated by its genes, so those proteins determine its metabolism.

Q9017.reason: In a lien-theory state a mortgage is only a lien, does not sever the joint tenancy, and is extinguished when the mortgagor dies so the survivor takes free of it.
